name: @rankcli/cli
description: RankCLI - Ship code, get ranked. SEO meets CI/CD.

scripts.build: npm run build:checks && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: npm run update-version && tsup src/index.ts src/wasm-engine.ts --format cjs,esm --dts
scripts.build:checks: test -d ../agent-runtime && (cd ../agent-runtime && pnpm build:wasm) || echo 'agent-runtime not present as a monorepo sibling - build.rs will fall back to the node_modules-installed bundle'
scripts.build:wasm: cd native && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --release && cd .. && node scripts/finish-wasm.js
scripts.build:wasm:dev: cd native && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --dev && cd .. && node scripts/finish-wasm.js --no-verify
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run inject-config

author: Brian Sam-Bodden
